text:
Sophia: Quick sync — final announce cadence for v0.9.2 (go-live tomorrow 10:00 PT). Need: final changelog, docs link, canary timing, and webinar slot confirmation. Trying to keep launch thread tight.

Mike: On changelog — will drop PR in 30m: `https://git.redwood/inference/changelogs/pull/492`.

Anya: Docs team will publish docs + how-to by EOD. Staging URL will be `https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/v0.9.2` — will swap to prod on deploy.

Cal: Webinar notice ready. Landing page points to /learn/webinar?release=v0.9.2, but need final docs link before we send invites.

Mike: Canary window suggestion: 09:30–09:50 PT for 5% traffic, then 09:50–10:00 PT ramp to 25% if no errors. Full at 10:00 PT. Can do feature-flag rollouts.

Sophia: Perfect. @Mike please paste the changelog link here when PR merges. @Anya confirm the production docs URL once swapped so we can lock webinar emails.

DeployBot: Deploy job queued: `deploy v0.9.2` — canary start scheduled `2024-04-12T09:30:00-07:00`.

Mike: PR merged — changelog here: `https://git.redwood/inference/changelogs/492/commits` and the rendered changelog: `https://console.redwood.ai/docs/changelog/v0.9.2`.

Anya: Docs swapped to prod: `https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/release-notes/v0.9.2` — also added short how-to for webhooks and embed changes.

Cal: Got it — locking webinar copy now. Sending invites at 14:00 PT today.

Sophia: Last check — embargo lift at 10:00 PT, social posts queued for 10:05 PT, support notified. Anyone see any blockers?

Mike: No blockers from infra. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Anya: Docs QA passed.

Cal: No blocker.

Sophia: Great — thanks all. I'll post the final announce thread at 10:00 PT and pin the changelog/docs links. :rocket:
